title: Microsoft Purview: Azure PST Import to Exchange Online mailboxes
summary: The briefing is supported by the roadmap, Microsoft's tenant notice and the cited Microsoft documentation. The rollout dates, licensing, storage charges and Azure role-assignment controls check out; feature-specific cmdlets and administrator roles remain undocumented.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters
claims.claim: Microsoft plans direct import of PST files stored in Azure Blob Storage into Exchange Online mailboxes.
claims.quote: Azure PST Import is a migration method that enables PST files stored in Azure Blob Storage to be imported directly into Exchange Online mailboxes.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls table
claims.claim: At the selected storage account resource, Azure portal exposes Access control (IAM) > Role assignments > Add > Add role assignment.

Click the specific resource for that scope.

Click the Role assignments tab to view the role assignments at this scope.
Click Add > Add role assignment.

claims.where: controls[1].api; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The printed az role assignment create call assigns Storage Blob Data Reader by assignee object ID and principal type at storage-account scope.
claims.quote:
az role assignment create \
    --role "Storage Blob Data Reader" \
    --assignee-object-id "aaaaaaaa-0000-1111-2222-bbbbbbbbbbbb" \
    --assignee-principal-type "User"

claims.where: controls[1].note; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Assigning the Azure role requires permission to assign roles at the storage account scope.
claims.quote: To run the command, you must have a role that includes Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/write permissions assigned to you at the corresponding scope or higher.
